questions.text: An audio classifier has high overall accuracy but often misses rare sound classes. Which metrics best reveal this weakness?

options.A: Top-1 accuracy and the total number of test clips.
options.B: Average training loss and total parameter count.
options.D: Inference speed and mean clip duration.

questions.explanation: Per-class recall exposes missed rare classes; macro F1 gives each class equal weight instead of letting common classes dominate.

questions.text: You use balanced sampling to train on an imbalanced sound dataset. How should you evaluate expected performance on the original deployment distribution?

options.A: Use a held-out set preserving the deployment class distribution.
options.B: Balance the test set and report only overall accuracy.
options.C: Evaluate on balanced batches drawn from the training clips.
options.D: Remove rare classes from evaluation to stabilize the score.

questions.explanation: Keep evaluation representative of deployment, separate from training, and include per-class metrics for imbalance.

questions.text: The summarize function concatenates per-coefficient means with population variances across frames. What does summarize([[1, 3], [3, 7]]) return?
questions.explanation: Means are 2 and 5; average squared deviations are 1 and 4. The function returns mean + var.
